abstract: This paper examines how Russian imports were reoriented after the 2022 sanctions. Using annual bilateral trade data at the product level, it asks whether direct Chinese export gains to Russia were concentrated in the same product lines in which EU exports to Russia declined. It also studies rerouting through Hong Kong, Armenia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Türkiye. The results point to substantial post-2022 import reorientation in Russia. Direct Chinese export gains are larger in product lines where Russia had depended more heavily on EU suppliers before the sanctions. Including transit-linked flows strengthens this relationship and points to broader rerouting through intermediary economies in those same product lines. In sanction-relevant goods, direct Chinese gains offset only part of the EU shortfall, while intermediary-country channels account for a substantial additional share. On the EU side, product-level evidence also suggests that some of the lost Russian market was absorbed through higher exports of the same products to other non-transit destinations. The evidence is therefore consistent with partial direct substitution by China, broader rerouting through intermediary economies, and partial outward redirection by EU exporters, not full replacement of lost EU exports.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2022年制裁后俄罗斯进口如何实现重新定向。利用产品层面的年度双边贸易数据，研究聚焦于中国对俄直接出口增长是否集中于欧盟对俄出口下降的同类产品线，并探讨了经由香港、亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和土耳其的转运路径。结果表明，2022年后俄罗斯进口出现了显著重新定向。在制裁前俄罗斯更依赖欧盟供应商的产品线上，中国直接出口增长更为显著。纳入转运关联流量后，这一关系得到强化，表明同类产品线通过中间经济体的转运范围更广。在制裁相关商品中，中国直接出口增长仅部分弥补了欧盟供应缺口，而中间经济体渠道则贡献了相当可观的额外份额。从欧盟方面看，产品层面证据亦表明，部分失去的俄罗斯市场份额被同一产品对其他非转运目的地的出口增长所吸收。因此，证据支持中国部分直接替代、通过中间经济体的广泛转运以及欧盟出口商的部分向外转向，而非对欧盟流失出口的完全替代。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Chinese Export Gains, EU Export Losses, and Russian Import Reorientation after the 2022 Sanctions
title_zh: 2022年制裁后中国出口增长、欧盟出口损失与俄罗斯进口转向

abstract: We propose an experimental design and data‑analytic method for eliciting and distinguishing the strict‑preference, indifference, and indecisiveness components of individual preferences in general choice environments. The design combines a forced‑choice treatment with a free‑choice treatment. In both treatments, subjects may select multiple alternatives from a menu. In the free‑choice treatment, subjects may also avoid or delay choice at a small expected cost. To analyze such data, we extend a standard non‑parametric goodness‑of‑fit criterion to accommodate multi‑valued choices. We apply it to evaluate the consistency of subjects’ 50 decisions with utility maximization and two models of incomplete‑preference maximization. Around 55% of subjects are well explained by one of these models, with 33% and 22% best explained by utility and incomplete-preference maximization, respectively. Revealed preferences typically feature non-trivial indifferences, and those that are incomplete often exhibit the predicted theoretical distinctions between indifference and indecisiveness, which are documented empirically for the first time.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种实验设计与数据分析方法，用于在一般选择环境中引出并区分个体偏好的严格偏好、无差异和犹豫不决成分。该设计结合了强制选择处理与自由选择处理。在两种处理中，受试者均可从菜单中选取多个备选项。在自由选择处理中，受试者还可以以较小的预期成本避免或延迟选择。为分析此类数据，我们扩展了标准的非参数拟合优度准则，以适应多值选择。我们将其应用于评估受试者50项决策与效用最大化及两种不完全偏好最大化模型的一致性。约55%的受试者能被这些模型中的一种很好地解释，其中33%和22%分别最佳解释为效用最大化和不完全偏好最大化。揭示出的偏好通常具有非平凡的無差异特征，而那些不完全的偏好往往展现出预测的理论区分，即无差异与犹豫不决之间的区别，这首次在实证中得到记录。
title: Eliciting and distinguishing between weak and incomplete preferences: Theory, experiment and computation
title_zh: 弱偏好与不完全偏好的引出与区分：理论、实验与计算

abstract: I derive a model of choice bracketing from two behavioral axioms in an expected utility framework. The first behavioral axiom establishes a link between narrow bracketing and correlation neglect. The second behavioral axiom identifies the reference point as the connector between broad and narrow preferences. The narrow bracketer is characterized by an inability to process changes from the reference point in different dimensions simultaneously. As a result, her tradeoffs between dimensions are distorted. She evaluates dimensions in isolation, implying a disregard for how they affect one another. When evaluating a dimension, she remains anchored to the reference point in the respective other dimension. This implies that she mistakenly perceives preference interactions in relation to the reference point. I present applications to portfolio choice, consumption bundle choice, and an exchange economy.
abstract_zh: 我在期望效用框架下，从两个行为公理推导出一个选择分框模型。第一个行为公理建立了窄分框与相关性忽视之间的联系。第二个行为公理将参考点识别为宽偏好与窄偏好之间的连接器。窄分框者的特征在于无法同时处理来自参考点在不同维度上的变化。因此，她在各维度之间的权衡被扭曲了。她孤立地评估各个维度，意味着忽视了它们之间的相互影响。在评估某一维度时，她仍锚定于另一相应维度上的参考点。这导致她错误地感知了与参考点相关的偏好交互作用。我将此模型应用于投资组合选择、消费束选择以及交换经济中。
title: Reference-dependent choice bracketing
title_zh: 参考依赖的选择分组

abstract: In this paper, we assess the impact of auditing final high school grades on educational and labour market outcomes, leveraging a 2007 reform in Italy that introduced external examiners. We extend the combined fixed effects method to estimate how the reform increased the earnings returns to higher education. We find that 90% of the reform effect is across occupations and higher for women. We show this impact was mediated by different higher education choices, unlocking opportunities in occupations and earnings they wouldn’t have had otherwise. We conclude that grade inflation associated to internal teachers assessment has detrimental effects on both educational and labour market outcomes.
title: The end of work feels near. How do people perceive the impact of digital technologies and automation?
title_zh: 工作终结似在眼前。人们如何看待数字技术和自动化带来的影响？

abstract: ABSTRACT While the relationship between football matches and crime has been well documented, little is known about whether such events also escalate violent interactions between police officers and civilians. This study addresses that gap by analysing use of force data from the Metropolitan Police Service in London to assess the impact of football matches on police behaviour. We find that on match days, the number of use of force incidents increases by an average of 0.772 in the boroughs where games are held. This effect is geographically concentrated around football stadium and is primarily driven by matches involving popular clubs, or those with violent fan bases. We find no evidence of spatial or temporal displacement of incidents. We also find some suggestive evidence that incidents may be more frequent in the case of unexpected losses. We make the case that despite the long‐standing association between football and crime, the effects are considerably smaller compared to other popular mass events.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管足球比赛与犯罪之间的关系已有充分记录，但人们对这类事件是否也会加剧警察与平民之间的暴力互动知之甚少。本研究通过分析伦敦大都会警察局的使用武力数据，评估足球比赛对警察行为的影响，以填补这一空白。我们发现，在比赛日，举行比赛的行政区中使用武力事件的数量平均增加0.772起。这一效应在地理上集中于足球场周边，并且主要由涉及热门俱乐部或拥有暴力球迷群体的比赛所驱动。我们未发现事件在空间或时间上发生转移的证据。我们还发现一些提示性证据表明，在意外失利的情况下，事件可能更为频繁。我们认为，尽管足球与犯罪之间长期存在关联，但与其他受欢迎的大规模活动相比，其影响要小得多。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Football Matches and Policing: Evidence From London
title_zh: 足球比赛与警务：来自伦敦的证据

abstract: ABSTRACT Personality traits play an important role in determining earnings; however, the specific behaviours related to personality traits that explain the earnings differentials remain unclear. Using panel data from Indonesia, we examine the associations between Big Five personality traits and employment and earnings, as well as the potential channels linking personality to these outcomes. We find that conscientiousness is a robust predictor of both employment and earnings. We further show that the association between conscientiousness and earnings is primarily accounted for by higher workload and possibly higher effort. Our findings highlight conscientiousness and related behaviours as potentially relevant targets for future policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 人格特质在决定收入方面发挥着重要作用；然而，与人格特质相关、能够解释收入差异的具体行为仍不明确。利用印度尼西亚的面板数据，我们考察了大五人格特质与就业和收入之间的关联，以及将人格与这些结果联系起来的潜在渠道。我们发现，尽责性是就业和收入的稳健预测因素。我们进一步表明，尽责性与收入之间的关联主要由更高的工作负荷以及可能更高的努力程度所解释。我们的发现凸显了尽责性及相关行为作为未来政策干预潜在相关目标的可能重要性。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Conscientiousness and Labour Market Outcomes
title_zh: 尽责性与劳动力市场结果

abstract: We examine how employee fears of automation-driven job displacement influence corporate disclosure of automation plans. Using a novel measure of local automation fear constructed from cable news transcripts, we document a robust negative relation between automation fear and firms’ propensity to provide forward-looking disclosure about automation strategies. This effect strengthens when disclosure conveys incremental information, when automation substitutes for labor, and when firms face greater union exposure or political costs. To strengthen identification, we exploit quasi-natural experiments that induce increases in automation fear, expected union resistance, and political costs, respectively. We also find suggestive evidence that firms increase private communication with investors to compensate for the reduction in public information provision. Overall, our findings shed light on the trade-offs between maintaining transparency and mitigating adverse employee and politician responses in the era of rapid technological advancement.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了员工对自动化导致的工作岗位流失的恐惧如何影响企业披露自动化计划的行为。利用从有线新闻转录中构建的新型地方自动化恐惧指标，我们记录了自动化恐惧与企业提供前瞻性自动化战略披露倾向之间的稳健负相关关系。当披露传递增量信息、自动化替代劳动力以及企业面临更高的工会风险或政治成本时，这一效应会增强。为强化因果识别，我们分别利用引发自动化恐惧上升、预期工会抵制增强及政治成本增加的准自然实验。我们还发现初步证据表明，企业会增加与投资者的私下沟通，以弥补公开信息供给的减少。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了在技术快速进步时代，维持透明度与缓解员工及政治人物不利反应之间的权衡关系。
title: Whispering progress: Fear of automation and voluntary disclosure
title_zh: 低语中的进步：自动化恐惧与自愿性披露

abstract: A zero price effect is a discontinuous change in demand when price is reduced to zero from a level arbitrarily close to it. It has been proposed that social norms play a role in zero price effects on consumption. We first conducted a norm-elicitation experiment to measure how people perceive the social appropriateness of consumption under zero versus minimal prices. We then ran a natural field experiment in the same contexts to observe actual taking behavior. Results show that the social appropriateness of consuming high quantities is significantly lower when goods are offered for free than when they are sold at 1 cent. Zero pricing increases the proportion of individuals who consume something, but reduces the average amount taken by those who consume positive amounts. Overall, the evidence suggests that high consumption of free goods is prevented by its social inappropriateness, potentially helping to explain the inconsistent evidence on the direction of zero price effects in previous studies.
abstract_zh: 零价格效应是指当价格从任意接近零的水平降至零时，需求发生的不连续变化。已有研究提出，社会规范在零价格对消费的影响中发挥作用。我们首先开展了一项规范诱导实验，以衡量人们在零价格与最低价格条件下对消费社会适当性的认知。随后，我们在相同情境下进行了一项自然田野实验，以观察实际获取行为。结果表明，当商品免费提供时，大量消费的社会适当性显著低于以1美分出售的情况。零价格增加了消费某种物品的个体比例，但降低了消费正数量个体的平均获取量。总体而言，证据表明免费商品的高消费因其社会不适当性而受到抑制，这或许有助于解释以往研究中关于零价格效应方向的不一致证据。
title: The role of social norms in zero price effects
title_zh: 社会规范在零价格效应中的作用

abstract: In societies with pronounced gender inequality, attractive women are often perceived as less competent leaders or confined to ornamental roles. Drawing on social role theory, institutional theory, and Upper Echelons theory, and integrating insights from research on gender inequality, beauty effects, and corporate philanthropy, we argue that attractive female CEOs strategically engage in philanthropy to counteract gender-based stereotypes, using such actions to signal compassion and social responsibility—qualities consistent with societal expectations of effective leadership. We further propose that the relationship between female CEO attractiveness and corporate philanthropy is moderated by contextual factors. Specifically, weaker gender stereotypes and more competitive markets that reward managerial talent should reduce the need for such compensatory behavior. Using data on Chinese firms, we examine the link between the physical attractiveness of female CEOs and corporate donations. The results show that attractive female CEOs engage more actively in philanthropy, contributing larger donations than their less attractive peers, particularly in regions with stronger gender stereotypes and less market-oriented economies.
abstract_zh: 在性别不平等显著的社会中，有吸引力的女性往往被视为能力较弱的领导者，或被局限于装饰性角色。借鉴社会角色理论、制度理论和高层梯队理论，并结合性别不平等、美貌效应及企业慈善领域的研究洞见，我们认为，有吸引力的女性CEO会策略性地参与慈善活动，以对抗基于性别的刻板印象，通过此类行为传递同情心与社会责任感——这些品质符合社会对有效领导力的期望。我们进一步提出，女性CEO吸引力与企业慈善之间的关系受到情境因素的调节。具体而言，较弱的性别刻板印象和更竞争激烈、奖励管理才能的市场，应会减少此类补偿性行为的必要性。利用中国企业数据，我们考察了女性CEO的外貌吸引力与企业捐赠之间的联系。结果显示，有吸引力的女性CEO更积极地参与慈善活动，其捐赠额高于外貌吸引力较低的同行，尤其是在性别刻板印象较强且市场化程度较低的地区。
china_relevance_reason: journal or topic scope is China economy
title: Female leadership, attractiveness, and corporate philanthropy
title_zh: 女性领导力、吸引力与企业慈善

abstract: This paper shows that the supply side of credit is a major factor for hampered monetary policy transmission in monopolistic banking markets. Our stress test data containing projected interest rates of all 1,555 small and medium‐sized banks in Germany under two hypothetical scenarios provide a clear way to partial out demand shocks that are unrelated to monetary policy; we are thus able to show that while market power banks charge higher loan rates, they spare their borrowers a part of exogenous monetary policy contractions and withhold a substantial part of rising rates from their depositors. Because high market power banks are relatively more profitable, these banks could be able to insure their relationship customers against adverse shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，在垄断性银行市场中，信贷供给方是阻碍货币政策传导的主要因素。我们基于压力测试数据，该数据包含了德国所有1555家中小型银行在两种假设情景下的预期利率，为剔除与货币政策无关的需求冲击提供了一条清晰途径；因此，我们能够证明，尽管拥有市场势力的银行收取更高的贷款利率，但它们却使借款人免受部分外生货币政策紧缩的影响，并从存款人那里扣留了相当一部分上升的利率。由于市场势力较强的银行相对更为盈利，这些银行或许能够为其关系客户提供保险，以抵御不利冲击。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Hampered Monetary Policy Transmission ‐ A Supply‐Side Story?
title_zh: 受阻的货币政策传导——供给侧的故事？

abstract: The paper presents empirical evidence on the international effects of U.S. fiscal policy from structural vector autoregressions identified through external instruments in a panel setting for the G7 countries. An exogenous increase in U.S. government spending is estimated to produce sizable positive responses of output and consumption in the rest of the G7 countries, both about half as large as their domestic U.S. counterparts, while strongly depreciating the U.S. terms of trade and lowering the U.S. trade balance and short‐run real interest rates. Moreover, fiscal shocks are estimated to have a strongly positive impact on hourly labor productivity in the private sector. We solve a two‐country New Keynesian model in closed form and show that a low cost elasticity of varying technology utilization can simultaneously explain the positive productivity, consumption, and international spillover effects as well as the real depreciation resulting from expansionary U.S. government spending shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文通过结构向量自回归模型，利用外部工具变量在七国集团小组设定中进行识别，提供了美国财政政策国际影响的实证证据。研究发现，美国政府支出的外生增加，对七国集团其他国家的产出和消费产生了显著的正向效应，其规模约为美国国内效应的一半，同时导致美国贸易条件大幅贬值，贸易余额下降，短期实际利率走低。此外，财政冲击对私人部门每小时劳动生产率具有强烈的正向影响。我们以闭式解形式求解了一个两国新凯恩斯模型，并证明较低的技术利用率成本弹性能够同时解释扩张性美国政府支出冲击所带来的正向生产率、消费及国际溢出效应，以及实际汇率贬值现象。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Fiscal Policy, International Spillovers, and Endogenous Productivity
title_zh: 财政政策、国际溢出效应与内生生产率

abstract: We extend the endogenous grid method to default risk models, which is faster and more accurate than grid search. Our method is 4 to 27 times faster and provides a more accurate bond price function, resulting in substantial differences in the predictions of the canonical sovereign debt model. When applied to Arellano's (2008) model, our approach predicts a standard deviation of the interest rate spread one‐third lower and defaults 3 to 5 times less frequently than does the conventional approach. Finally, we demonstrate that our method is applicable to a broad class of default risk models by characterizing sufficient conditions.
abstract_zh: 我们将内生网格方法扩展至违约风险模型，该方法比网格搜索更快且更精确。我们的方法速度快4至27倍，并提供更精确的债券价格函数，从而在经典主权债务模型的预测中产生显著差异。当应用于Arellano（2008）模型时，我们的方法预测的利率利差标准差比传统方法低三分之一，违约频率则低3至5倍。最后，我们通过刻画充分条件，证明该方法适用于广泛类别的违约风险模型。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: A Generalized Endogenous Grid Method for Default Risk Models
title_zh: 违约风险模型的广义内生网格方法

abstract: Using firm‐level data from emerging markets, we find that the dollar debt issuance significantly increases issuers’ risk‐taking. While the dollar debt issuance significantly increases issuers’ investment spending, it reduces their investment efficiency substantially. We also show that macroprudential policies can help mitigate the risk‐taking effect of dollar debt issuance. In addition, we provide evidence that nonissuers exhibit increased risk‐taking when faced with rising intraindustry competition pressure from issuers. Overall, the cross‐sectional risk distributions at the industry level are more tilted toward the downside.
abstract_zh: 利用新兴市场的企业层面数据，我们发现美元债务发行显著增加了发行者的风险承担。尽管美元债务发行显著提升了发行者的投资支出，却大幅降低了其投资效率。我们还表明，宏观审慎政策有助于缓解美元债务发行的风险承担效应。此外，我们提供证据显示，当面临来自发行者日益增长的行业内竞争压力时，非发行者也表现出增加的风险承担。总体而言，行业层面的横截面风险分布更倾向于下行方向。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Cheap U.S. Dollar Credit: Panacea or Poison? Firm‐Level Evidence from Emerging Markets
title_zh: 廉价美元信贷：灵丹妙药还是毒药？来自新兴市场的企业层面证据

abstract: We produce the first measure of Divisia money for Mexico. Various structural VAR identifications with Divisia M4 as an indicator of monetary policy yield responses of production and prices that are in every case at least as sensible as—and generally offer an improvement over—their counterpart specifications with a short‐term offer rate as the indicator. Importantly, we find that our Divisia specifications do not require expanding the model's information set with commodity prices or the real exchange rate for a resolution of the price puzzle. We reach similar conclusions for Mexico to those Keating et al. (2019) arrive at for the U.S. economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了墨西哥首个Divisia货币度量指标。采用多种结构VAR识别方法，以Divisia M4作为货币政策指标，所得产出与价格响应在各类情形下至少与以短期利率为指标的对应设定同样合理，且通常表现更优。重要的是，我们发现Divisia设定无需在模型信息集中加入大宗商品价格或实际汇率即可解决价格之谜。我们得出的关于墨西哥的结论，与Keating等人（2019）针对美国经济的研究发现相呼应。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: A Divisia Measure of the Money Supply for Mexico
title_zh: 墨西哥货币供给的Divisia测度

abstract: Abstract Direct lenders, nonbank credit intermediaries with low leverage, have become increasingly important players in corporate loan markets. In this paper, we investigate the role they play in the monetary policy transmission mechanism, using U.S. dollar syndicated loan data covering the 1997–2018 period. We show that direct lenders are more likely to join loan syndicates whenever monetary policy announcements trigger a contraction in borrowers' net worth irrespective of the directional change in interest rates. Thus, our findings suggest that direct lenders dampen the financial accelerator channel of monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 摘要 直接贷款人，即杠杆率较低的非银行信贷中介，在企业贷款市场中扮演着日益重要的角色。本文利用1997年至2018年期间的美元银团贷款数据，探讨了它们在货币政策传导机制中的作用。我们发现，每当货币政策公告引发借款人净资产收缩时，无论利率方向如何变化，直接贷款人更倾向于加入贷款银团。因此，我们的研究结果表明，直接贷款人削弱了货币政策的金融加速器渠道。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Dampening the Financial Accelerator? Direct Lenders and Monetary Policy
title_zh: 抑制金融加速器？直接贷款机构与货币政策

abstract: This paper uses neoclassical monetary demand theory to measure the welfare cost of inflation. It uses the microeconomic‐ and aggregation‐theoretic approach to the demand for money, that integrates the demand for money with the demands for consumption and leisure, and provides a comparison between the consumer surplus approach based on Marshallian demand functions and the compensating variation approach based on Hicksian demand functions. The paper also reports new estimates of the welfare cost of inflation based on Hicksian money demand functions and the compensating variation approach.
abstract_zh: 本文运用新古典货币需求理论来衡量通货膨胀的福利成本。采用基于微观经济学与加总理论的方法研究货币需求，将货币需求与消费及闲暇需求相结合，并比较了基于马歇尔需求函数的消费者剩余方法与基于希克斯需求函数的补偿变差方法。文章还基于希克斯货币需求函数和补偿变差方法，报告了通货膨胀福利成本的新估计值。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: On Measuring the Welfare Cost of Inflation
title_zh: 论通货膨胀福利成本的衡量

abstract: Using survey data from Germany, we study heterogeneity in how households form inflation expectations. We elicit (i) uncertainty in perceptions of current inflation and (ii) how persistent households perceive inflation to be. Combining these with standard survey questions on inflation, we infer laws of motion for expectations at the individual level. Based on averages alone, a standard model calibrated to our data predicts inflation shocks generate small and transitory responses in expectations and consumption. The considerable heterogeneity we observe in expectation formation, however, amplifies the transmission to aggregate consumption by an order of magnitude, and substantially increases its persistence. This amplification enables the model to match the large consumption effects of the temporary Value Added Tax (VAT) cut in Germany in 2020.
abstract_zh: 利用德国的调查数据，我们研究了家庭在形成通胀预期方面的异质性。我们分别获取了（i）对当前通胀感知的不确定性，以及（ii）家庭认为通胀的持续性程度。结合标准调查问卷中关于通胀的问题，我们推断出个体层面预期的动态变化规律。仅基于平均值，一个根据我们数据校准的标准模型预测，通胀冲击对预期和消费产生的影响既小且短暂。然而，我们在预期形成过程中观察到的显著异质性，将传导至总消费的效应放大了一个数量级，并显著增强了其持续性。这种放大效应使模型能够匹配2020年德国临时增值税（VAT）削减所带来的大规模消费影响。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Heterogeneity in Imperfect Inflation Expectations: Theory and Evidence from a Novel Survey
title_zh: 不完全通胀预期中的异质性：基于新调查的理论与证据

abstract: Using responses of credit default swap indices to European Central Bank (ECB) monetary policy announcements, we isolate a novel credit policy component of monetary policy surprises. We examine how such unconventional monetary policy surprises affect asset markets. Easing credit surprises lead to a somewhat delayed decline in corporate‐bond yields and cause declines in option‐implied measures of uncertainty about credit risk. Easing credit surprises also boost equity markets. Both net and gross corporate‐bond issuance increase as a result of easing credit surprises, with the largest response in investment grade issuance.
abstract_zh: 利用信用违约互换指数对欧洲央行（ECB）货币政策公告的反应，我们分离出货币政策意外中一个新颖的信贷政策成分。我们考察此类非常规货币政策意外如何影响资产市场。宽松的信贷意外导致公司债券收益率出现一定延迟的下降，并引发期权隐含的信用风险不确定性指标下降。宽松的信贷意外还提振了股票市场。由于宽松信贷意外，公司债券的净发行和总发行均增加，其中投资级发行的反应最为显著。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Market Effects of Central Bank Credit Markets Support Programs in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲央行信贷市场支持计划的市场效应

abstract: Using unique contract‐level data from the Czech labor market, we investigate how monetary policy shocks, identified by the high‐frequency surprises in interest rate futures, affect the distribution of wages and hours worked. Consistent with existing literature, our findings indicate that low‐wage groups are more impacted by these shocks than high‐wage counterparts. The novelty lies in our exploration of the heterogeneous effects across different demographic and sectoral groups. Our results reveal that age, education, sector of employment, and the length of employment contracts play important roles in how wages and working hours respond to policy shocks.
abstract_zh: 利用捷克劳动力市场中独特的合同级数据，我们研究了通过利率期货高频意外变动识别的货币政策冲击如何影响工资与工作时间的分布。与现有文献一致，我们的发现表明，低收入群体受这些冲击的影响大于高收入群体。创新之处在于我们探讨了不同人口统计特征和行业群体间的异质性效应。结果显示，年龄、教育程度、就业部门以及雇佣合同期限在工资和工作时间对政策冲击的反应中扮演重要角色。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Heterogeneous Effects of Monetary Policy Shocks: Evidence from the Czech Labor Market
title_zh: 货币政策冲击的异质性效应：来自捷克劳动力市场的证据

abstract: This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性混频面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数均存在异质性的线性设定。为应对异质性与协变量之间的潜在相关性，我们首先证明：在额外标准化条件下，均值组估计量能够获得一致且渐近正态的斜率估计，但权重估计量存在偏误。作为替代方案，我们提出采用广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高采样频率被观测时，这两种估计量的实施方法。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估其有限样本性质。作为实证例证，我们运用该框架重新考察了气温波动对经济增长的影响。
title: Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Data Models With Mixed Sampling Frequencies
title_zh: 混合抽样频率下异质性面板数据模型的估计

abstract: For many technologies and behaviors, an agent’s benefit from adopting depends on his contacts adopting, and the benefit to his contacts of adopting depends on their contacts adopting. This paper examines how the architecture of these connections shapes the success or failure of the diffusion of innovations. We start with a standard model of diffusion with the key addition that some agents can coordinate their decisions. This captures the idea that people often talk and make decisions together with friends or family to adopt technologies. We show that insularity of connections, that is, the extent to which agents tend to concentrate their connections to a narrow set of other agents, determines contagion. However, whether insularity helps or hinders depends on the technology being diffused. For technologies that are valuable even without many contacts adopting, we find insular connections hinder adoption, but for technologies that are valuable only when many contacts adopt, insular connections facilitate adoption.
abstract_zh: 对于许多技术及行为而言，个体采纳的收益取决于其社交圈中他人的采纳情况，而他人采纳的收益又取决于其自身社交圈的采纳状况。本文探讨了这些连接结构如何影响创新扩散的成败。我们以标准扩散模型为基础，关键创新在于允许部分主体协调其决策。这反映了人们常与亲友共同商议并决定是否采纳技术的现实。研究表明，连接的封闭性——即个体将连接集中于狭窄群体的程度——决定了传染效应。然而，封闭性对扩散的促进或阻碍作用取决于技术特性：对于无需大量社交圈采纳即可产生价值的技术，封闭性会抑制采纳；而对于需依赖大量社交圈采纳才能体现价值的技术，封闭性反而促进采纳。
title: The Architecture of Social Networks and the Diffusion of Innovations
title_zh: 社交网络结构与创新扩散

abstract: Accurate understanding and modelling of complex nature land dynamics is essential for effective nature conservation and land-use planning, particularly in and around metropolitan areas where diverse land-use demands compete for limited space. However, existing modelling frameworks often overlook stakeholder interactions by relying solely on spatial drivers such as land suitability, and tend to oversimplify land-use dynamics by focusing on a single land-use type, ignoring the competing pressures from other land uses. To address this gap, this study proposes a stakeholder-integrated land-use competition (SI-LUC) model that integrates stakeholder interactions, defined by decision-making and negotiation processes, into a multi-type land-use competition framework. The model was applied to simulate nature land dynamics in the Randstad metropolitan area from 2012 to 2023. Results show that SI-LUC improves simulation performance compared to a widely used conventional model, achieving around 5% increase in the global Figure of Merit (FoM). Moreover, the sensitivity analysis confirms the effectiveness of stakeholder-related parameters in SI-LUC, such as negotiation costs and thresholds to agree, in regulating the intensity of stakeholder interactions and shaping nature land changes. Additionally, the scenario analysis highlights the model’s potential as a virtual laboratory for testing governance strategies on nature conservation, enabling decision-makers assess the long-term effects of different nature governance approaches and facilitating a more informed, context-sensitive land-use planning in complex urban contexts.
abstract_zh: 准确理解与模拟复杂的自然土地动态对于有效的自然保护和土地利用规划至关重要，尤其是在大都市区及其周边地区，那里多样化的土地利用需求在有限空间内相互竞争。然而，现有的建模框架往往仅依赖土地适宜性等空间驱动因素，忽视了利益相关者之间的互动，并且倾向于通过聚焦单一土地利用类型来过度简化土地利用动态，忽略了其他土地利用带来的竞争压力。为弥补这一不足，本研究提出了一种利益相关者整合的土地利用竞争（SI-LUC）模型，该模型将利益相关者互动（由决策和谈判过程定义）整合到多类型土地利用竞争框架中。该模型被应用于模拟2012年至2023年间兰斯塔德大都市区的自然土地动态。结果表明，与广泛使用的传统模型相比，SI-LUC提高了模拟性能，全球品质因数（FoM）提升了约5%。此外，敏感性分析证实了SI-LUC中利益相关者相关参数的有效性，如谈判成本和达成一致的阈值，这些参数在调节利益相关者互动强度和塑造自然土地变化方面发挥作用。另外，情景分析凸显了该模型作为虚拟实验室的潜力，可用于测试自然保护治理策略，使决策者能够评估不同自然治理方法的长期影响，并促进在复杂城市背景下进行更明智、更具情境敏感性的土地利用规划。
china_relevance_reason: 3 位疑似中文姓名作者，且摘要/题名包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
title: A stakeholder-integrated land-use model for nature conservation in metropolitan areas: The case of the Randstad, Netherlands
title_zh: 面向大都市区自然保护的整合利益相关者土地利用模型：以荷兰兰斯塔德为例

abstract: Most models on the life-cycle utilization of health care consider the expected development of an individual’s health. However, health shocks with significant impact (e.g. the onset of a chronic disease or life-threatening accidents) should not be averaged, as they can put the life-course onto a different trajectory. This paper presents an optimal-control framework incorporating a stochastic health shock with individuals allocating their resources to consumption and various types of health care over their life-cycle. We distinguish between general health care and shock-specific prevention, acute, and chronic care. We investigate the optimal decisions (on consumption, saving, and health care) made in anticipation and the optimal reaction to the shock depending on the timing of its arrival. Furthermore, we extend the value of life concept to the multidimensionality of health and the scope for a shock and illustrate our findings by calibrating the model to an individual facing a potential cancer diagnosis in the US. In so doing we also investigate the role of possible bias in the subjective expectation of a health shock.
abstract_zh: 大多数关于生命周期内医疗保健利用的模型考虑的是个体健康状况的预期发展。然而，具有重大影响的健康冲击（如慢性疾病的发生或危及生命的事故）不应被平均化处理，因为它们可能将生命历程引向不同的轨迹。本文提出一个最优控制框架，纳入随机健康冲击，个体在其生命周期内将资源分配于消费及各类医疗保健。我们区分了一般医疗保健与针对冲击的预防、急性及慢性护理。我们研究了在预期冲击情况下做出的最优决策（涉及消费、储蓄及医疗保健），以及根据冲击发生时间而采取的最优应对措施。此外，我们将生命价值概念扩展至健康的多维性及冲击的影响范围，并通过将模型校准至美国面临潜在癌症诊断的个体来阐述我们的发现。在此过程中，我们还探讨了主观预期健康冲击中可能存在的偏差所起的作用。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: Integrating large health shocks into life-cycle models - modelling impacts of a cancer diagnosis
title_zh: 将重大健康冲击纳入生命周期模型——癌症诊断影响的建模

abstract: In this paper, we characterize a forecasting model where forecasters cannot perfectly distinguish between the two persistent components (trends and cycles) in a dynamic setting. In this model, forecasters jointly update their beliefs about the two components: noisy information about one component is used to update beliefs about the other component. We present diagnostic empirical facts on forecasting behaviors and show that these facts are consistent with our model’s predictions while contradicting those of existing models in the expectation formation literature. To validate our model, we exploit the Federal Reserve’s 2012 adoption of explicit inflation targeting as a policy shock. Structural estimation reveals that this policy change altered the underlying data-generation process, and the corresponding changes in forecasting behavior indeed align with our model’s predictions. Finally, we characterize how this rational confusion mechanism interacts with behavioral biases such as overconfidence and show that this interaction can address the well-known persistent forecast error puzzle in the literature.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了一个预测模型，在该模型中，预测者无法在动态环境中完美区分两个持久性成分（趋势与周期）。在此模型中，预测者联合更新关于这两个成分的信念：关于一个成分的噪声信息被用于更新关于另一个成分的信念。我们提出了关于预测行为的诊断性经验事实，并表明这些事实与我们的模型预测一致，同时与预期形成文献中现有模型的预测相矛盾。为验证我们的模型，我们利用美联储2012年采用明确通胀目标制作为政策冲击。结构估计揭示，这一政策变化改变了潜在的数据生成过程，且相应的预测行为变化确实与我们的模型预测相符。最后，我们刻画了这一理性混淆机制如何与过度自信等行为偏差相互作用，并表明这种相互作用能够解决文献中著名的持续预测误差之谜。
title: Expectation and confusion: Evidence and theory
title_zh: 期望与困惑：证据与理论

abstract: Residential energy use is a major contributor to total energy consumption and CO 2 emissions, and energy costs can take up high shares of household spending. In this context, we make three contributions to the literature. First, using a discrete choice experiment with 1,389 prospective homebuyers in Sweden, we investigate how homebuyers account for energy efficiency of buildings compared to other attributes when looking for a new home. Second, we elicit forecasts from a sample of 252 realtors whom we ask to predict homebuyers’ preferences, allowing us to shed light on the role these important mediators play regarding energy efficiency in the housing market. Third, we estimate how providing prior information on homebuyers’ choices affects realtors’ forecasting accuracy. For homebuyers, we find that energy efficiency ranks low overall. Realtors’ forecasting accuracy is lower for the energy efficiency attribute. Providing realtors with more prior information has sizeable positive effects on forecasting accuracy, and information also affects self-reported difficulty of and confidence in the forecasts.
abstract_zh: 住宅能源使用是总能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的主要来源，能源成本在家庭支出中占据较高比例。在此背景下，我们为相关文献做出三项贡献。首先，通过对瑞典1389名潜在购房者进行离散选择实验，我们研究了购房者在寻找新住房时如何权衡建筑能效与其他属性。其次，我们收集了252名房地产经纪人的预测样本，要求他们预测购房者的偏好，从而揭示这些重要中介在住房市场能效方面所扮演的角色。第三，我们评估了向房地产经纪人提供购房者选择的先验信息对其预测准确性的影响。研究发现，购房者对能效属性的整体重视程度较低。房地产经纪人对能效属性的预测准确性也较低。向房地产经纪人提供更多先验信息能显著提升预测准确性，同时信息还会影响其自我报告的预测难度和信心水平。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Realtor Forecasting Accuracy on Homebuyer Preferences for Energy Efficiency
title_zh: 房地产经纪人关于购房者能效偏好预测的准确性

abstract: Agent-based models are valuable tools for agricultural policy evaluation. They can represent the heterogeneity of farmers and farmer interactions and are especially useful when behavioural and social factors are integrated to represent farmers’ decision-making. We assess the potential of agent-based models by conducting a review of forty-eight agent-based models developed for European agriculture and a survey with twenty-six modellers and twenty-four policy stakeholders. We find that while agent-based models provide nuanced representations of farmers’ decision-making processes, there is a gap between what is currently implemented in models, what modellers consider important and what policymakers expect.
abstract_zh: 基于智能体的模型是农业政策评估的重要工具。这类模型能够刻画农户的异质性及其互动关系，尤其在整合行为与社会因素以表征农户决策过程时具有独特价值。我们通过梳理48个针对欧洲农业开发的智能体模型，并对26位建模者及24位政策利益相关方开展问卷调查，评估了此类模型的潜力。研究发现：尽管智能体模型能细致呈现农户决策过程，但当前模型的实际应用、建模者认为重要的要素与政策制定者的预期之间仍存在显著差距。
title: Behavioural and social factors in farm-level agent-based models for European agricultural policy evaluations
title_zh: 欧洲农业政策评估中农场层面基于主体模型的行为与社会因素

abstract: Using the initial impoundment of the world’s largest hydroelectric dam as a natural experiment, we assess how farming households adapt to dam-induced seasonal water scarcity. We find that the impoundment of the TGD for power generation has altered the Yangtze River’s water cycle, seasonally reducing downstream water supply and causing rice yields to fall. In response to a persistent 12% decline in yields, subsistence households primarily expanded their farming area to maintain total output. While some households reallocated labor to non-agricultural sectors, this adaptation was significantly constrained by wealth endowment.
abstract_zh: 以全球最大水电站初期蓄水作为自然实验，我们评估了农户如何适应大坝引发的季节性水资源短缺。研究发现，三峡大坝为发电而蓄水改变了长江的水循环，季节性减少了下游供水，导致水稻产量下降。面对持续12%的产量下滑，自给型农户主要通过扩大耕作面积来维持总产出。尽管部分农户将劳动力重新配置到非农部门，但这种适应方式受到财富禀赋的显著制约。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: How do smallholder farmers adapt to water scarcity? Evidence from the three Gorges Dam
title_zh: 小农户如何适应水资源短缺？来自三峡大坝的证据

abstract: Crop residue burning (CRB) remains a persistent contributor to air pollution and environmental degradation in South and Southeast Asia, imposing significant health and productivity costs. While policies have emphasized regulatory enforcement and technological alternatives, the behavioral and socioeconomic drivers of CRB are less well understood. This study examines how farmers’ perceptions, social norms, resource access, and socioeconomic characteristics jointly relate to CRB decisions, by drawing on a conceptual framework from the agricultural literature that synthesizes behavioral dimensions of farmer practices. Using original survey data from 1,030 rice farmers in twelve subdistricts across three high-burning provinces near Bangkok, Thailand, we estimate logistic regression models that incorporate interactions between perceptions and socioeconomic aspects. Results show that perceptions—such as viewing CRB as a widespread norm and recognizing its effects on the environment, soil quality, and health—significantly relate to burning behavior; though these effects vary by farm size, education, and resource access. By modeling how perceptions interact with socioeconomic characteristics, this study advances the understanding of behavioral mechanisms and farmers’ attitudes towards environment, soil quality, health, and social aspects of CRB. The findings highlight the importance of integrating behavioral insights into policy design, aligning information dissemination with local contexts, and enabling viable alternatives to burning. Systematically accounting for farmer perceptions could offer actionable pathways for reducing CRB’s environmental impact while promoting sustainable agricultural practices in Thailand and comparable contexts.
abstract_zh: 作物残茬焚烧（CRB）仍是南亚和东南亚空气污染与环境退化的持续来源，造成巨大的健康与生产力损失。尽管政策侧重于监管执法和技术替代方案，但CRB的行为与社会经济驱动因素尚不明确。本研究基于农业文献中综合农户实践行为维度的概念框架，考察农户认知、社会规范、资源获取及社会经济特征如何共同关联于CRB决策。利用来自泰国曼谷附近三个高焚烧省份十二个分区1,030名水稻农户的原始调查数据，我们估计了纳入认知与社会经济方面交互项的逻辑回归模型。结果表明，认知——如将CRB视为普遍规范以及认识到其对环境、土壤质量和健康的影响——与焚烧行为显著相关；尽管这些效应因农场规模、教育程度和资源获取而异。通过建模认知与社会经济特征的交互作用，本研究增进了对行为机制及农户对环境、土壤质量、健康和社会层面CRB态度的理解。研究结果强调了将行为洞察纳入政策设计、使信息传播与地方情境相匹配以及提供可行焚烧替代方案的重要性。系统性地考虑农户认知可为减少CRB的环境影响提供可行路径，同时促进泰国及类似情境下的可持续农业实践。
title: Heat after the Harvest: Farmer Choices and Perceptions of Crop Residue Burning in Thailand
title_zh: 收获后的热浪：泰国农民对秸秆焚烧的选择与认知

abstract: Several studies have underscored the significance of familiarity and collegiality in shaping judicial behavior in US federal courts. However, the distinct features of the US judicial system limit the ability to formulate a general theory. This research draws on 84,335 appellate decisions from Taiwanese courts to examine the role of familiarity in a career judge system. In Taiwan, lower court judges are transitorily promoted to appellate courts for 3 years, after which they typically return to their district courts before some of them are permanently promoted. By comparing their reversal patterns during temporary and subsequent permanent promotions to those of permanent appellate judges, we find that transitorily promoted judges reverse less frequently, and judges generally favor district courts where they have previously served. Social identity is likely a key explanatory factor. The size, diversity, and random allocation of cases in our dataset strengthens the generality of judicial behavior theories.
abstract_zh: 多项研究强调了熟悉度与同僚关系在美国联邦法院司法行为中的重要性。然而，美国司法体系的独特性限制了构建普适性理论的能力。本研究基于台湾法院的84,335份上诉判决，探讨职业法官体系中熟悉度的作用。在台湾，地方法院法官会临时晋升至上诉法院任职三年，之后通常返回原审法院，其中部分法官最终获得永久晋升。通过比较这些法官在临时晋升与后续永久晋升期间与常任上诉法官的改判模式，我们发现：临时晋升法官的改判频率较低，且法官普遍倾向于偏袒其曾任职的地方法院。社会认同可能是关键解释因素。本数据集在规模、多样性及案件随机分配方面的优势，增强了司法行为理论的普适性。

title: How judges’ social identity impacts reversal decisions: evidence from the transitory promotion of judges
title_zh: 法官社会身份对改判决策的影响：基于法官临时晋升的证据
